sections.Intro: This remedy is indicated in cases of skin diseases and glandular disorders. It is useful in cases of eczema and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general tendency to enlarged glands and a feeling of debility.
sections.Skin: Eczema, with much itching and burning. Scabby eruptions. Impetigo.
sections.Glands: Enlarged glands in the neck and other parts of the body.
